title: Lifting an affine open from a generic fibre
statement: Let X and S be affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], S integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], f:X -> S, and eta a generic point of S. For every affine open U in the fibre X_eta [def-pc-scheme-fibre], there is an affine open V in X and an isomorphism e:V_eta -> U commuting with the maps to X and to Spec kappa(eta). No finite presentation hypothesis on f is required.

source.place: Tags 01Z4 and 01Z6, descending quasi-compact opens and affineness; Tag 0GWT, spectrum of the local ring as the limit of affine neighbourhoods.

proof.text: Use the affine-open basis to make affine neighbourhoods of eta a nonempty cofiltered diagram. The existing Scheme.fromSpecStalk_limit_affine_neighbourhoods gives the limit cone with point Spec of the stalk. The stalk at a generic point of an integral scheme is a field (Mathlib isField_stalk_of_closure_mem_irreducibleComponents); its residue map is therefore an isomorphism. Transport the cone along Spec of this isomorphism to obtain the canonical cone with point Spec kappa(eta). The private nhdsCone_limit proof implements this transport and uniqueness explicitly.

Take the top affine neighbourhood as base stage. Base change the canonical limit cone by f and identify its limit with X_eta through its fibre pullback square. Affine schemes and affine transition maps satisfy the base-change limit hypotheses.

Apply Mathlib exists_isAffineOpen_preimage_eq: descend the quasi-compact open by Tag 01Z4, and then shrink the stage until it is affine by Tag 01Z6. Obtain an affine open O in a base restriction of X whose inverse image is U.

The projection q from the restriction to X is an open immersion. Its image V=q(O) is affine. Injectivity of q and the projection equation show that the inverse image of V under the fibre inclusion is U. Paste the open-restriction square with the fibre square; its canonical pullback comparison gives the required isomorphism and both projection equations.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_open_lift_of_generic_fibre
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (U : (f.fiber η).Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧
      ∃ e : (V.ι ≫ f).fiber η ≅ U.toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ U.ι ≫ f.fiberι η = (V.ι ≫ f).fiberι η ≫ V.ι ∧
        e.hom ≫ U.ι ≫ f.fiberToSpecResidueField η =
          (V.ι ≫ f).fiberToSpecResidueField η
